text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 5) 2017.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh dari 13 Oktober 2017 hingga 22 Oktober 2017.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kambing tempatan bertulang

2. Daging kambing import bertulang

3. Daging biri-biri import bertulang

4. Tomato

5. Cili merah

6. Kacang dal (Australia)

Dibuat 6 Oktober 2017

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4Jld.8; PN(PU2)188/X]

DATO' SERI HAMZAH BIN ZAINUDIN

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 5) ORDER 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the

Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 5) Order 2017.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for

the period from 13 October 2017 to 22 October 2017.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Local bone-in mutton

2. Imported bone-in mutton

3. Imported bone-in lamb

4. Tomato

5. Red chilli

6. Dal (Australia)

Made 6 October 2017

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4Jld.8; PN(PU2)188/X]

Co-operatives and Consumerism
